nom: Clinique Clinique For Men Face Wash Oily Skin Formula

segments.oily: Most reviewers describe naturally oily skin (face, nose, or T-zone) and report the wash left skin matte, less shiny, and controlled oil throughout the day, though a minority (including one 1-star user) found it made their skin more oily and shiny.
segments.combination: One reviewer notes the line comes in oily, normal or dry formulas and recommends matching the correct one to the user's skin.
segments.normal: One reviewer mentions using the men's line across oily, normal and dry family members without detailing normal-skin effects specifically.

concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers with oily skin report reduced shine and less oil throughout the day, sometimes noticing oiliness return quickly if use is skipped; one reviewer reports the opposite, with skin becoming more oily and shiny after use.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fewer breakouts, dried-up old pimples, or cleared blackheads and impurities, but one reviewer describes a line of large pimples developing and a forehead breakout after continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Users mention visible improvement in teenage or adult acne and blemishes with regular use, with one long-term teenage user needing continuous use to prevent relapse.

extraits.titre: Thought it would be great... it sucked
extraits.texte: The only problem I have with my skin is that it's very oily. My pores are naturally very small and my skins not too prone to breaking out unless I'm eating lots of oily food or not drinking enough water. After the first use I loved this, it left my face matte and helped clear up a couple pimples i had at the time. A few days later however i noticed that my pores had gotten bigger so to give the product a fair chance i stopped using it to see if my pores would shrink again, in case it was a diet thing, and then go back to it. After about a week I started using the face wash again and not only did my pores get bigger again but, my skin had started to peel, and my skin was much more susceptible to breaking out ( I've watched a line of four huge pimples grow on my cheek overnight and my forehead get covered with smaller ones). This is my second Clinique oil control product that has completely flopped for me and I don't plan on buying another from them.

extraits.titre: Not What I Expected from Clinique
extraits.texte: I have used other Clinique products before but this was the first Men's product I have ever purchased. Sadly, I was disappointed. It actually made my skin more oily and shiney. I thought as a guy, this would be perfect since my skin is already oily but sadly after 9 days of use, I needed to discontinue as I saw no results, only adverse ones. The product did not make my skin feel clean or refreshing like other Clinique products. Therefore, I returned it and exchanged it for what I know works and for a product I do like. I currently use Clinique Foaming Sonic Facial Soap. Now this product works and feels great!

Feels so clean in my skin though i have an oily skin which this product help to kill my oily skin it gives me a cool feeling after washing and i feel this works for me and no break outs at all...i recommend this product to follow with men's clinique oil control mattifying expoliating toner use this toner with cotton balls to cleanse more then to follow with the mattifying oil control moisturizer...ive been doing the routine mornings and nights...loving it...

My husband has very oily skin to the point he has to wipe his face & his face can get very shiny due to it. I purchased this on a whim for him & I cannot get over the difference! No oil or shine at all! Definitely will continue purchasing this product !
He complained about oily skin, so I got him this product the next day he saw even old pimples dry up
This is the only skin cleanser that works for my son who has tried everything for his acne! Works great!

I'm out numbered 1 to 7 by the male members of my household, and over the years the Clinique mens line has become a go to for me. We have have found it works well for each. Remember to pay attention to the skin formula your needs between oily, normal or dry.
